returnedProbes.why: Claude Code's F-REVIEW-RETURN.md returned the first version of this lane with three current-to-timeless P0s. These probes are measured at the ROUTE (routeAskR2 with prior work in the conversation), not at the reader, because that is where the defect was visible: the reader's job was only half of it, the other half was IR freshness and whether news was required.
invariants: past reference ("you said / did you say / earlier / your previous answer") may resolve prior work
present advice or opinion language ALONE is never a prior-work reference
explicit currentness always survives — nothing here may make a current turn timeless
"You said X — is it still true now?" keeps BOTH the prior reference and the current evidence requirement
returnedProbes.howToRead: expect.sameAsBase true means the route must be bit-for-bit what 782b175 produced: this lane may not touch it. expect.job / irFreshness / ref / news are the asserted route values.
